env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/good.a ./good
! stderr .
! logos build -o $WORK/bad.a ./bad
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! exists $WORK/bad.a

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/constgaps

go 1.27

require example.com/constgaps/lib v0.0.0

replace example.com/constgaps/lib => ./lib

-- w/lib/go.mod --
module example.com/constgaps/lib

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package lib

func Identity[T any](x any) T { return x.(T) }

-- w/good/good.lgo --
package good

import "example.com/constgaps/lib"

type Qualified interface { const Name() string }
type Good struct { N string }
func (g Good) Name() string { return g.N }
func Identity[T any](x T) T { return x }
type StoreBox[T any] struct { V T }
var _ Qualified = Identity[Qualified](Good{})
var _ = StoreBox[Qualified]{V: Good{}}
var _ = lib.Identity[int](any(7))

-- w/bad/bad.lgo --
package bad

import "example.com/constgaps/lib"

type Qualified interface { const Name() string }

func Use(v any) Qualified { return lib.Identity[Qualified](v) }
